# Procedural Three.js Models & img2threejs Pipeline

Pure SaaS supports code-only, procedural Three.js component synthesis in TypeScript with zero binary asset dependencies.

---

## 1. Commands

```bash
# Verify Three.js prerequisites
npx pure-saas 3d check

# Scaffold a production Three.js component with lifecycle disposal
npx pure-saas 3d scaffold HeroScene --out src/components/HeroScene.tsx

# Generate 6-pass sculpting specification from an input image
npx pure-saas 3d spec assets/device.png --out 3d-spec.json
```

---

## 2. Component Architecture

Every procedural 3D model conforms to the strict `ProceduralModel` contract:
```typescript
export interface ProceduralModel extends THREE.Group {
  userData: {
    tick: (delta: number, elapsed: number) => void;
    dispose: () => void;
  };
}
```

### Lifecycle Rules
- Geometry and materials are tracked in disposal arrays.
- On React component unmount (`useEffect` cleanup), call `model.userData.dispose()` and `renderer.dispose()`.
- Maximum polygon count: Under 5,000 triangles to guarantee 60fps on mobile devices.
